lines: Look, I can put in a good word with the cops if you help me. What's the next job?
Talk now or I'll make you hurt. Where's your boss?
Are you hurt? Did you hear what those Hellions were saying?
Hi there! Anything strange going on around here?
Who runs the Hellions in this area?
Give it up, Cinder. Who are you working with now?
Don't do this, Cinder. I know about your daughter, Lily. She deserves better than a dad in the Zig.
Stop this. Think of your daughter.
